intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Tavri is holding a stack of papers tied with a plain blue ribbon.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “A countess just called this ribbon ‘a daring statement of royal taste.’”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “It was the only ribbon in the drawer. The alternative was string.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “The chronicles will be unbearable. *She chose blue, and the kingdom wept.*”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Underneath, the papers are covered in small, anxious handwriting.

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “It’s from the baker. A petition. Their roof leaks onto the bread.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “The ribbon’s had four compliments. You’re the first to ask about the bread.”

options.labelText: “Next time go for velvet. If they love the ribbon, give them more ribbon.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Velvet. Bold. The chronicles will need a second volume.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She makes a note about velvet on the back of the petition.
